info.title: RetriEval.Cli
info.description: CLI tool for RetriEval: init, run, compare, and generate retrieval evaluation golden sets.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: retrieval-eval — RetriEval CLI for evaluating RAG retrieval quality.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold a starter golden-set JSON file and a retrieval-eval config in the target directory.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory in which to scaffold the files.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a retrieval evaluation using the in-memory FakeRetriever (for local smoke tests). Wire a real IRetriever by using RetriEval.Core from code.

options.name: --golden-set
options.description: Path to the golden-set JSON file.

options.name: --output
options.description: Base path for output reports (without extension).

options.name: --k
options.description: Number of results to retrieve per query.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format(s): markdown, json, html. Repeat for multiple.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Diff two JSON report files and surface regressions, improvements, and aggregate deltas.

options.name: --fail-on-regression
options.description: Exit with code 1 when regressions are detected (useful as a CI gate).

arguments.name: BASELINE
arguments.description: Path to the baseline JSON report.

arguments.name: CURRENT
arguments.description: Path to the current JSON report.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Synthesise a starter golden set from a corpus using an LLM. ⚠ Output requires human review before use in CI. Requires RETRIEVAL_EVAL_LLM_ENDPOINT and RETRIEVAL_EVAL_LLM_KEY environment variables pointing at an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.

options.name: --corpus
options.description: Path to a JSON file containing an array of RetrievedChunk objects.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the generated golden-set JSON.

options.name: --queries-per-chunk
options.description: Number of queries to generate per chunk (1–5).

options.name: --category
options.description: Optional category tag to apply to all generated cases.
